what.text: This page follows refugees from Sierra Leone in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8925 refugees from Sierra Leone.
France hosts the largest share, 22.7%, followed by Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone from 1991 to 2001, with the RUF, AFRC, Kamajors and WSB, at war level in some of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1992 to 2000, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1988 at 8 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 490047, at the end of 1999, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
